task: S2: what the MODEL_PROMPT_PRIVACY refusal on two Tower 3 plan page stores protects, and the options
base: staging 44c40f83 (S1 merged as 49076e9b); E3 receipt read from staging af317fe7
qualification: Offline: no provider call, no key read, no network request, no runtime read, no held-out file.

whatItRefuses: A string whose first non-blank character is { or [ (or which starts and ends with a double quote) is
read as JSON that was encoded into a string. It must parse to its last character; if it does not,
the whole request is refused. The only exemption is a string that starts with [redacted ...] (:25).
why: Comment at :18-21: an ambiguous or truncated structure never falls back to forwarding the unprocessed
text. Inside parsed JSON the minimizer masks by key (credential fields :70, personal fields :71-77).
Text that looks like JSON but cannot be parsed has no key context, so a keyed secret or personal value
in it could not be found; the rule refuses it instead of sending it as prose.
tests: tests/model-gateway/control.test.ts:102-107: a truncated {"apiKey":... string, 41 nested brackets and
an escaped credential key inside prose are each refused with MODEL_PROMPT_PRIVACY; :57-58 and :86-93
show a parsed credential field masked and numbers kept exact.
callersRelyingOnIt: model-gateway/adapter.ts:41 minimizeMessages (every message of every request)
model-gateway/gateway.ts:46 ModelGateway.propose, before admission, replay or dispatch
model-gateway/adapter.ts:99 SarvamAdapter (again, with the key), :150 control and :163 replay adapters
usp/ingestion/source-fusion-associations-projection.ts:54, :73, :221 (catch the refusal and drop the text)
ai/officer-ai-provider.ts:129; scripts/agent/live-proof.ts gatewayBody (the plan's own pre-check)

step0.whatTheGuardProtectsHere: Nothing on these two lines: they are prose that begins with a stray bracket. The rule cannot tell that from truncated JSON, and refusing is its designed answer.

licenceAndClass.datasetsJson: haryana-2831-tower3-plan1.pdf: permission.state unconfirmed (redistribution and reuse licence not verified), trainingPermission unconfirmed. d2-rera-storey-source-truth-20261010: terms unconfirmed, 'Owner-approved public local development; no source-specific launch/redistribution/training grant'.
licenceAndClass.sourceRecord: storey-truth/demo/haryana-2831-tower3.json: split demo, purpose test_only, permission unconfirmed, both PDFs retrieved from the public Haryana RERA portal without a login.
licenceAndClass.class: public, demo. Neither document is private or restricted.
licenceAndClass.mayPageTextGoToTheProvider: Not barred by the private-or-restricted rule, and the storey agent's own policy admits public development and demo documents. The licence is unconfirmed and the owner's recorded approval says local development: the same qualification S1 stated for all six planned storey calls. It is an owner line in the approval, not a reason to drop these two.
licenceAndClass.alsoSentFromTheseStores: Each request holds the architect's title-block contact line (plan 1 p1-l322, plan 2 p1-l252 and the address-only p1-l253), selected because it holds the word Unit. The minimizer masks the mobile number and the e-mail; the office address and the office landline go as read. This is E3's finding F2 on these two sheets.

a.what: The storey part selection asks the minimizer about each selected line and leaves out a line it refuses; the selection returns the omitted lines (part id, page, line index, code), and the plan and receipt record them.
a.changes: document-storey-agent.ts part selection only. The parts, their hash, the closed citation schema and the answer check all exclude the line, so an answer citing it is invalid.
a.risks: The line is not asked. Here it is a table total label; other sent lines of each sheet carry the same floor words (plan 1: 4 lines with the refuge words, plan 2: 4 with the typical-floor words), and it holds no storey count, floor expression, height or unit count. Nothing the guard refuses is ever sent.

b.what: The builder removes the leading bracket and records it, so the rest of the line is sent.
b.changes: The text sent differs from the stored line; a quote from it still sits inside the stored line.
b.risks: The builder would rewrite provider-bound text until a privacy guard stops firing, which needs its own rule for 'this bracket is not structure' beside the minimizer's. Where the two disagree, a keyed personal value from truncated JSON goes out as prose, where only patterns are masked. It is the minimizer's rule changed from outside.

c.what: A narrower JSON test in the minimizer.
c.risks: Changes the privacy rule for every caller above: the lead's and owner's decision, not built here.

mappingSide.source: E3 receipt on staging af317fe7: findings F1 and gatewayRefusals (17 of 50 mapping requests, 2 of 8 storey batches).

cause.masker: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/column-profile.ts:92-100 maskColumnSample writes whole-sample tokens [absent] (:93), [null] (:94), [array] or [object] (:95), [blank] (:98); maskPatterns (:53-62) writes [email], [PAN:...], [Aadhaar:...], [phone:...]
cause.minimizer: model-gateway/redaction.ts:24-27: a sample is one JSON string leaf of the request, so text() sees it alone and a leading [ sends it to the JSON parser
cause.checkedHere: Of the 9 tokens that can begin a masked sample, 8 are refused when they do ([absent], [array], [object], [blank], [email], [PAN:...], [Aadhaar:...], [phone:...]); only [null] parses as JSON and passes. A token after other text passes. E3 observed [blank] 13, [absent] 4, [object] 1 (one table holds two kinds): 17 requests.

liveProofCalls.why: The two mapping calls are the first chunk of mi-d10-01.csv and mi-d10-02.csv; mi-d10 is not among E3's 17. The six storey calls passed; the two Tower 3 plans were the refused ones and were already under neverSent.
liveProofCalls.whyTheDryRunShowedIt: The plan builds every request and passes it through minimizeMessages (live-proof.ts gatewayBody) before it is planned, so a refused request is listed under neverSent and never becomes a step. The dry run then sends each planned request through ModelGateway.propose, which minimizes before the replay adapter; the adapter saw 8 of 8 planned hashes, so all 8 had passed the minimizer.

changeMaskerTokens.what: Whole-sample tokens that no longer start with a bracket (column-profile.ts:93-99 and the two regexes at :83 and :99 that keep them atomic and idempotent).
changeMaskerTokens.requestHashesChanged: Only requests whose profile holds a changed token: the 17 refused today. The other 33 of 50 keep their profile hash, request hash and replay key, provided [null] and the four pattern tokens are left as they are.
changeMaskerTokens.recordings: 0 by construction: every mode minimizes before the adapter (gateway.ts:46), so no recording made through the gateway can be keyed by a profile holding these tokens. The runtime recordings folder was not read (not allowed here), so this is derived, not counted.
changeMaskerTokens.trackedReplayFixtures: 0 (no mapping recording is tracked in Git)
changeMaskerTokens.teacherLabelLines: 0 of T1 (44 compared), T1c (198 lines) and T1d (21 lines) change key: a line is keyed by profileId, the hash of family, file, sheet and column (scripts/agent/t1-profiles.ts:58), not of the samples. T1b produced no labels. Whether a rationale quotes a token was not checked.
changeMaskerTokens.pinsThatMoveIfProfilesAreRegenerated: 2: profilesSha256 in t1/prep.json (411 columns) and in t1b/result.json (193 columns)
changeMaskerTokens.learnerFeatures: 0 of 9 feature extractors in services/geo/geo/usp_learning/stage_a.py read maskedSamples
changeMaskerTokens.staleCaptures: 2 UI evidence captures (gf-agent/ui/f2b/responses.json, gf1/ui/f3a/table-responses.json) each show 55 [blank] and 10 [absent]; no studio source names a token
changeMaskerTokens.leftOpen: A sample that begins with a pattern token (a column of e-mails or phones) is still refused; E3 saw none in the 50. 2 of the 17 (mi-d22, 54 KB and 53 KB bodies) stay refused by the size bound, so 15 become askable.

narrowerMinimizerTest.what: The minimizer stops reading known mask tokens or non-JSON brackets as JSON.
narrowerMinimizerTest.cost: 0 hashes, labels or features change; it changes the privacy rule for all 9 call sites above. Lead and owner decision; not built.

leave.cost: 17 of 50 development tables (and any table with a blank, absent or compound sample cell) can never be asked live; they fail closed to manual mapping.

mappingSide.recommendation: Change the four whole-sample tokens that fail ([absent], [array], [object], [blank]) in the masker and leave [null], the pattern tokens and the minimizer alone: 15 of the 17 become askable, and no recording, label key or learner feature moves.
